# Hartwell Labs — Bartosz Osiej

> Systems engineer & founder. Post-quantum cryptography, eBPF security tooling, programming languages, and a post-quantum Bitcoin. Everything MIT-licensed, built in the open, Poland.

Main site: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/

## Projects

### pqbit
Post-quantum Bitcoin: ML-DSA-44/SLH-DSA (FIPS 204/205) signatures from genesis, UTXO + PoW, fair-launch constitution (zero premine, founder stash ≤100 coins never moved). Testnet node in Rust live, genesis parameters open for review.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/pqbit
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/pqbit/
Genesis draft: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/pqbit/blob/master/GENESIS.md

### talus-process-monitor
eBPF ransomware detection & response for Linux (Rust + eBPF): sliding-window heuristics over syscalls, automated SIGKILL response, 280k events/s at ~7.6% CPU.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/talus-process-monitor
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/talus-process-monitor/

### quantum-shield
Post-quantum file encryption CLI (pqguard): ML-KEM-768 (FIPS 203) + AES-256-GCM, fuzz-tested.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/quantum-shield
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/quantum-shield/

### fortis
Post-quantum measured boot for Linux.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/fortis
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/fortis/

### externum
Programming language that compiles to Python, standalone Bash, and bytecode. Self-hosted, ~379 tests, browser REPL.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/externum
Playground: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/externum/

### NV2_ENGINE
Rust voxel engine (wgpu) with MeMLP neural terrain from NASA real-climate data. Powers Vivia: Beyond The Known.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/NV2_ENGINE
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/NV2_ENGINE/

### linux-aegis
Linux security module.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/linux-aegis
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/linux-aegis/

### Aurora
OS in the browser.
Repo: https://github.com/BartoszOsiej/Aurora
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/Aurora/

### The Stitcher Trilogy
Crime horror novels by Bartosz Osiej, published on Amazon Kindle.
Landing: https://bartoszosiej.github.io/thethreadcalls/
